items.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a single transparent cut-paper object for a medical hand-drawn collage animated short. Handmade tactile collage, genuinely layered torn rag paper, charcoal edge drawing, colored-pencil shading, old-print halftone scraps, subtle paper fibers. Warm cream, muted ochre, dusty coral, muted teal. Soft irregular cut edges, narrow natural contact shadows within the object. NOT a flat cartoon, NOT a rectangular illustration card, NOT a page, NOT an infographic. No text, no labels, no arrows, no tape outside object, no extra objects, no detached atlas panels, no background. One coherent object occupies most canvas with 6% clear margin, true transparent alpha. An adult neck lower front cutaway medical paper collage, upper chin and neck to top chest, trachea centered, a small bilobed butterfly-shaped thyroid hugging sides of trachea and connected by isthmus across lower anterior trachea. Thyroid proportionate to neck, thyroid is NOT huge, no brain, no heart, no tumor. Skin outer border of cream paper, thyroid dusty coral collaged layers, trachea pale blue-gray ringed paper. No detached pieces or duplicate organs.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: full-frame 16:9 1280x720 landscape paper-theatre stage background for imaginative medical hand-drawn collage animation. Every visible surface and room object built from layered torn real paper, magazine scraps, printed textures, graphite hatching, tiny sewing marks and natural contact shadows. Handmade stop-motion cutout craft aesthetic with abundant tactile detail across the entire frame. Avoid large plain color cards, UI panels, infographic, PPT slide, decorative floating lines, gradients, glossy 3D or photorealism. No readable text, no letters, no logo. Natural paper environment depth, leave lower 18% low-contrast textured floor/table edge for subtitles; leave upper left small unobtrusive area for brand. An imaginative small everyday apartment with a dressing shelf, open door onto a hallway, clock at the left, plant, torn-paper curtains and nightstand at right, textured rug lower frame. Morning. Center left (x .25-.48, y .18-.68) has natural room depth for a complete animated standing person, center right has a chair and small side table for a journal. No person. No medical symbols.
